description: Companies that have filed with the SEC to go public in the US (S-1 or F-1) and have not listed yet: name, stage (filed, priced or listed), proposed ticker, website, and first and latest filing dates. Use for "what IPOs are coming up?" or "is X going public?". Nothing on the list can be bought until it lists; to follow one and be alerted when it prices, send the user to the IPO page under Invest in the Moneda app. Returns available:false when market data is off for the user.
name: get_upcoming_ipos
